# Incident with Actions, Issues, API Requests and Pull Requests

## What Changed

Oct 26, 18:57 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Oct 26, 18:54 UTC Update - We saw elevated latency affecting REST API requests, including Checks, and some Actions, Issues, Pull Requests, and GraphQL functionality. Some requests may have been slow or timed out, and notifications were delayed from 17:59 UTC - 18:40 UTC. We mitigated the issue and all services have recovered. Oct 26, 18:50 UTC Monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Oct 26, 18:48 UTC Investigating - We are investigating reports of degraded performance for API Requests, Actions, Issues and Pull Requests
